name: 7-chlorolorcaserin
summary: 7-Chlorolorcaserin, also known as (1R)-7,8-dichloro-1-methyl-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-1H-3-benzazepine, is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist of the 3-benzazepine family related to the previously marketed appetite suppressant and anti-obesity drug lorcaserin (Belviq). It is specifically the 7-chloro derivative of lorcaserin.

pharmacology.text: 7-Chlorolorcaserin is a potent agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors. Its EC50 values were 10 nM at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, 40 nM at the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor, and 4.0 nM at the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor. As such, the drug only showed about 2.5-fold selectivity for the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor over the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.text: 7-Chlorolorcaserin, also known as (1R)-7,8-dichloro-1-methyl-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-1H-3-benzazepine, is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist of the 3-benzazepine family related to the previously marketed appetite suppressant and anti-obesity drug lorcaserin (Belviq).

summaryZh: 7-氯氯卡色林，化學名-7,8-二氯-1-甲基-2,3,4,5-四氫-1H-3-苯並氮雜環庚三烯，是一種有機化合物，化學式為C11H13Cl2N。它是一種一種血清素5-HT2受體激動劑。它是食慾抑制劑和減肥藥氯卡色林的結構類似物，最初於2005年被文獻報道。
summaryZhHans: 7-氯氯卡色林，化学名-7,8-二氯-1-甲基-2,3,4,5-四氢-1H-3-苯并氮杂环庚三烯，是一种有机化合物，化学式为C11H13Cl2N。它是一种一种血清素5-HT2受体激动剂。它是食欲抑制剂和减肥药氯卡色林的结构类似物，最初于2005年被文献报道。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Unlike lorcaserin, it strongly switches on the 5-HT2B receptor, and drugs that do so have been linked to damage to heart valves and to pulmonary hypertension.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與氯卡色林不同，它會強力活化5-HT2B受體，而具有這種作用的藥物曾被認為與心臟瓣膜損傷及肺動脈高壓有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与氯卡色林不同，它会强力活化5-HT2B受体，而具有这种作用的药物曾被认为与心脏瓣膜损伤及肺动脉高压有关。

fact.en: Its parent, lorcaserin, was sold as a weight-loss drug called Belviq but was withdrawn in 2020 after a trial suggested a higher rate of cancer among people taking it.
fact.zh: 它的母體氯卡色林（lorcaserin）曾以「Belviq」之名作為減重藥販售，但在2020年因一項試驗顯示服用者癌症發生率較高而撤出市場。
fact.zhHans: 它的母体氯卡色林（lorcaserin）曾以「Belviq」之名作为减重药贩售，但在2020年因一项试验显示服用者癌症发生率较高而撤出市场。
